svg.title: The trust equation as a fraction: three parts on top, self-orientation below.
svg.desc: Trust equals a fraction. On top, added together: credibility, what you say; reliability, what you do; and intimacy, how safe it is to be vulnerable with you. Below the line, highlighted: self-orientation, how much your focus is on yourself. The more of it, the less trust all three add up to.

g.text: how much your focus is on yourself
